newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-ENGLAND V ITALY TEAMS FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND V ITALY TEAMS FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE MATCH.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday Tournoi de France soccer match between England and Italy at the Beaujoire Stadium:
England - 13-Tim Flowers; 3-Stuart Pearce, 5-Gareth Southgate, 15-Martin Keown, 14-Philip Neville, 4-Paul Ince, 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-David Beckham, 19-Paul Scholes, 10-Teddy Sheringham, 20-Ian Wright

Italy - 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 7-Angelo di Livio, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 5-Fabio Cannavaro, 6-Alessandro Costacurta, 15-Antonio Bennarivo, 4-Dino Baggio, 8-Roberto di Matteo, 10-Demetrio Albertini, 11-Gianfranco Zola, 9-Pierluigi Casiraghi
